functions.description: build battle record and localized copy
functions.notes: Only difference: after 2nd GetProtagonist the ROM has `mov r7,r0; cmp r7,#0; beq` where we emit `movs r7,r0; beq` (4 bytes). Everything else is byte-identical once aligned. Ruled out (all still fold to movs): if(p2)/!=NULL, bool local, inline bool IsValid, if(==NULL){}else, assign-in-condition, inline getter wrapper, GameObject* local, reusing prot, bit/level inits after call, explicit else-zero, local Ext150* e, body reorder, unsigned >0. `(int)p2 > 0` gives the right mov+cmp and size but ble instead of beq (SHAPE 1). Ternaries -> predicated code; inline with out-pointers -> OVERGEN 40; u8 bit/level -> UNDERGEN 12. colorsweep best is a trick (bit=0; bit=bit+...), not applied. Source left unchanged.
